article.title: Estimating when the Soviets could produce a nuclear weapon
article.excerpt: Following up on Alex's post on Soviet economic growth forecasts , I was intrigued to read the 1940s estimates, emanating from the United States, about when the Soviets would obtain a nuclear weapon.
